## Summary

**Verdict: ONE venv suffices — the two-venv fallback (§4.1) is NOT needed.** Applio@pin (`c817f1f`) + Kokoro 0.9.4 + AudioSeal 0.2.0 + the `daemon-constraints.txt` pins resolve with zero conflicts and install cleanly into a single Python 3.12 venv on this M1 Mac. 157 packages, ~81 s wall-clock, no build failures, no missing arm64 wheels, no compiler invoked (Xcode CLT present but irrelevant to the install).

## Baseline (`sw_vers; xcode-select -p; python3 --version`)

- macOS 27.2 (build 26B118), arm64, 51 GiB free on /tmp volume
- Xcode CLT installed at `/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools`
- System python 3.14.8 (brew), pip 26.2.1, **no `uv`** installed
- `portaudio`, `espeak-ng` NOT installed; `ffmpeg` present via brew

## Key constraint findings (from PyPI metadata, before installing)

- **Python must be 3.12** (not system 3.14): `kokoro`/`misaki` require `python <3.13,>=3.10`, and `preshed==3.0.9` ships arm64 wheels only up to cp312. `brew install python@3.12` → 3.12.16 in **24.5 s**.
- `spacy` latest (3.8.14) wants `preshed<3.1.0,>=3.0.2` → the `preshed==3.0.9` pin is **compatible, no conflict**.
- Every compiled dep has macOS-arm64 wheels for cp312: torch 2.11.0, torchaudio 2.11.0, numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.18.0, faiss-cpu 1.14.3 (single `cp310-abi3` wheel, forward-compatible), onnxruntime 1.31.0, numba/llvmlite, blis, srsly, tokenizers/safetensors (abi3). kokoro/audioseal/transformers/librosa are pure-Python. `espeakng-loader` ships an arm64 wheel **bundling `libespeak-ng.dylib`**.

## Exact commands run (all in `/tmp/cyv-b0-m1`, repo untouched)

1. Fetched `requirements-engine.txt` @pin via `curl` (40 lines: torch==2.11.0, numpy==2.4.6, transformers==5.13.1, …)
2. `python3.12 -m venv /tmp/cyv-b0-m1/venv`
3. `pip install --dry-run -r combined.txt` (applio reqs + kokoro==0.9.4 + audioseal==0.2.0 + `-c daemon-constraints.txt`) → **resolved zero conflicts in 13.9 s**; notably selected setuptools-81.0.0, protobuf-7.36.2, pillow-13.0.0, matching `notebooks/constraints.txt`
4. `pip install torch==2.11.0 torchaudio==2.11.0 numpy==2.4.6` → **21.5 s**, all wheels
5. `pip install -r applio-req.txt kokoro==0.9.4 audioseal==0.2.0 -c daemon-constraints.txt` → **59.5 s**; only `docopt` built from sdist (pure-Python, succeeded); everything else wheels
6. Smoke tests (no model downloads, no training): torch import + `mps_available=True`; `kokoro.KModel/KPipeline` import OK under transformers 5.13.1; `misaki.en.G2P()` produced phonemes end-to-end (auto-fetched `en_core_web_sm-3.8.0` from GitHub in ~6 s, bundled espeak-ng dylib loaded — **no `CYV_ESPEAK_LIBRARY` fallback needed on this Mac**); `sounddevice` imports without portaudio; audioseal 0.2.0 imports.

## Timings / deps table

| Step | Time | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `brew install python@3.12` | 24.5 s | required; system 3.14 rejected by kokoro/misaki/preshed |
| `pip install --dry-run` (full set) | 13.9 s | 0 conflicts |
| Real install, torch stack | 21.5 s | wheels only |
| Real install, everything else | 59.5 s | wheels + 1 pure-Python sdist |
| **Total real install** | **≈81 s** | venv footprint **1.6 GB, 157 pkgs** |
| Cold `import torch` | 7.8 s | MPS built + available |
| Needs Xcode CLT | **none** | no compilation occurred |
| Lacks arm64 wheel | **none** | of the pinned set |

## Versions resolved

torch 2.11.0, torchaudio 2.11.0, numpy 2.4.6, transformers 5.13.1, kokoro 0.9.4, misaki 0.9.4, spacy 3.8.14, preshed 3.0.9, audioseal 0.2.0, faiss-cpu 1.14.3, onnxruntime 1.31.0, scipy 1.18.0, numba 0.68.0/llvmlite 0.50.0, soundfile 0.14.0, soxr 1.1.0, en_core_web_sm 3.8.0 (auto-fetched; pre-install this exact version in `cyv setup`).

## Failures

None in install. One test-script bug (mine, not the stack): `EspeakngLoader` isn't the class name in `espeakng_loader` — corrected to `get_library_path()`/`misaki.en.G2P()`, which passed.

## Open questions (need follow-up, not blockers)

- KModel forward pass untested — needs 327 MB Kokoro weights download (skipped per minimal-download rule); transformers-5.13.1 compat verified at import level only.
- AudioSeal embed/detect and faiss index ops untested (need weights / fixtures).
- `sounddevice` imports without portaudio, but actual audio-device use at daemon runtime is untested — likely unneeded (file I/O only); confirm or add `brew install portaudio` to `doctor`.
- `cyv setup` uses `uv`, which isn't installed here — pip was a proxy; re-verify resolution under `uv pip compile` when writing the lockfile. Experiment venv left at `/tmp/cyv-b0-m1/venv` for reuse/cleanup.
